tutorial.trickDisplay: Current trick. 4 players in 2-vs-2 partnership (seats 0+2 vs 1+3). Must follow suit; must trump when void. Points: A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2 (120 total).
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Holding both K and Q of the same suit and leading one declares a marriage and sets trump (40 pts if current trump, 20 pts otherwise).
tutorial.playButton: Select a card and play it. Leading a King or Queen of a marriage declares trump.
tutorial.info: Marjapussi is a Finnish 4-player 2-vs-2 partnership game. 36-card deck (6-A), 8 cards each, 4 hidden pussi (berry bag) cards. The winner of trick 8 captures the pussi. First team to 500 wins.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
